offering_description.value: Goosehead sells insurance primarily to households and also serves small businesses. Its corporate and franchised agents compare policies from multiple carriers, place coverage, and service policies.

primary_products.value: Homeowners insurance; auto insurance; flood insurance; personal umbrella insurance; small-business insurance

primary_services.value: Insurance brokerage; policy servicing; insurance agency franchising

customer_segment.value: B2C: Homeowners, homebuyers, renters, and drivers; B2B: Small businesses seeking coverage and entrepreneurs buying insurance agency franchises

end_markets.value: Personal property and casualty insurance; small-business property and casualty insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Insurer commissions on new and renewed policies; licensing or royalties: Initial franchise fees and ongoing royalties paid by franchisees; service fees: Agency fees charged to policyholders on certain new policies
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; licensing or royalties; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Sources policies from multiple insurers and places coverage for households and small businesses; service provider: Provides training, technology, and centralized policy servicing to agency franchisees

geography_served.value: US national: Across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Home, auto, and other personal coverage, small-business coverage, and insurance agency franchising

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: Corporate and franchised insurance agents; online: Online insurance quote and inquiry tools; partners / resellers: Referrals from mortgage lenders and real estate professionals

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State insurance departments license agencies and producers and regulate insurance sales practices
